name: Sleeve Knot
description: Knot a foe's sleeve to the foe's own belt with qi so the arm cannot rise.

name: Cord Parry
description: Whirl a short cord of qi to slap aside a thrust before it lands.

name: Pull Step
description: Anchor a cord to a distant stone and step along its pull in one quick bound.

name: Knot Tally
description: Count the knots a foe has tied on a line to learn which ones are still live.

name: Hand Over Hand
description: Climb a cord of qi hand over hand to close on a bound foe while the line stays taut.

name: Master Loop
description: Cast a loop that finds the target's moving limb and cinches before it can withdraw.

name: Paired Knot
description: Tie one knot on a foe and its twin on a post so the foe is drawn toward the post.

name: Partner Cord
description: Link a line to a partner so the two share the weight of a heavy lift.

name: Linked Guard
description: Link two guards of qi so a blow on one is spread across both.

name: Pair Strike
description: Strike with one hand while a cord in the other pulls the foe onto the blow.

name: Pair Sense
description: Sense through a line which of two linked beings is the weaker.

name: Shared Strain
description: Tie the user to a willing ally so a part of each hit on one is carried by the other.

name: Twin Snare
description: Drop two snares of qi at once onto two foes who stand close together.

name: Burden Knot
description: Knot a line of qi between two allies so a tired one leans on the other.

name: Held Weight
description: Take the shock of a blow on a line shared with an ally so neither falls.

name: Even Pull
description: Match steps with a bound ally so both move at the pace of the slower.

name: Shoulder Cord
description: Loop a cord over both of a foe's shoulders and draw them back.

name: Cord Check
description: Check a line shared with an ally for fraying before a hard push.

name: Dragging Hitch
description: Hitch a foe's heavy gear to the ground so each stride is a drag.

name: Burden Share
description: Split the weight of an ally's injury or fatigue across a bond so each carries half.

name: Weight Return
description: Send the pain carried on a shared line back through the cord into the foe who caused it.

name: Cord Cast
description: Cast a drawn line of qi across a foe's path so it snags the front foot.

name: Cord Hold
description: Hold a drawn line steady at waist height so none can charge past at a run.

name: Draw Back
description: Draw the body backward along a line to escape a lunge.

name: Cord Pluck
description: Pluck a drawn line like a string and read the echo for hidden movement.

name: Drawn Net
description: Draw many lines at once into a net that closes round a foe's torso.

name: Cord Breaker
description: Snap a foe's own tied line so the half-formed technique tied to it unravels.

name: Two-Knot Hold
description: Tie one knot on a foe's hand and one on the foe's ankle so the body bends.

name: Crossed Cord
description: Run a line between two foes so each must watch where the other steps.

name: Mutual Guard
description: Bind two allies back to back so each guards the other's blind side.

name: Tied Courage
description: Send a calm pulse down a line to an ally to steady a shaking hand.

name: Between Sense
description: Feel the bond between two beings to learn whether it is willing or forced.

name: Pair Bind
description: Tie two foes' wrists together so each hampers the other's swing.

name: Bond Lock
description: Lock a bond so a foe's qi cannot cut or loosen it for a short span.

name: Knot End
description: Find the loose end of a knot with a touch of qi to see how it was tied.

name: Weak Turn
description: Pinch a binding at its weakest turn with two fingers to loosen it a notch.

name: Thread Pull
description: Pull one thread of a hobbling knot to free an ally's leg.

name: Gentle Unbind
description: Ease a loose binding from an ally's arm with care to leave the skin whole.

name: Counter Turn
description: Turn the foe's cord aside by looping it back on its own line.

name: Slack Cut
description: Slash through a tied cord with the edge of the hand.

name: Unpicking Touch
description: Pick apart a binding laid on an ally by a foe until the limbs move free.

name: Drag Release
description: Draw a clinging taint out along a loosed cord so the ally recovers from its drag.

name: Counter Knot
description: Tie a knot against a foe's binding so both cancel and fall slack.

name: Anchor Cord
description: Run a line from the belt to a heavy stone so the user holds ground against a shove.

name: Haul Knot
description: Knot a haul line round a ledge and swing up to it.

name: Cord Weight
description: Hang a weight of qi on a line round a foe's waist to slow the stride.

name: Pole Sense
description: Feel which fixed thing a line is tied to and how firmly it holds.

name: Anchor Drop
description: Drop a heavy anchor of qi on a line round a foe so the foe cannot rise or run.

name: Drawing Cord
description: Reel a bound foe back along the line step by step while the foe fights the pull.
